name: How do I choose the right style of bathroom trim and molding?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right style of bathroom trim and molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right style of bathroom trim and molding depends on your home's architectural style and your personal design preferences. For traditional homes, intricate profiles like colonial or fluted casings can add elegance. Modern bathrooms often benefit from simpler, clean-lined trim like flat stock or square edge profiles. Consider the scale of your bathroom; a smaller space might feel overwhelmed by very wide or ornate molding. Consistency with other trim throughout your home can create a cohesive flow, but the bathroom is also an opportunity to introduce a unique, complementary style. Our team can help guide your selection to match your vision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose bathroom trim and molding based on your home's architectural style, personal preferences, and the scale of the room, ensuring it complements the overall design.
